plain.li: I'll keep the seat warm for you, {OTHER_nameDef}.
The colony made its choice, and it wasn't you.
Don't take it hard, {OTHER_nameDef}, some of us are just better at it.
You can always try again for {OFFICE}, if you like losing.
Count the votes again if it makes you feel better.

cold.li: The vote was clear, {OTHER_nameDef}, so accept it.

blunt.li: You lost, {OTHER_nameDef}, so stop sulking about it.

plain.li: You pulled me out of there, {OTHER_nameDef}, and I won't forget it.
I'd be lying out there still if you hadn't come for me.
Thank you for coming back for me, {OTHER_nameDef}.
Whatever you need, {OTHER_nameDef}, you only have to ask.
I don't remember much, but I know it was you who carried me.

cold.li: You took a risk for me, {OTHER_nameDef}, and I noted it.

cheerful.li: My hero, {OTHER_nameDef}, and I mean it.
